### Marquee
A row of logos, images or text that scrolls without end.

Component ID: `marquee`

[Component documentation](https://www.expressivecss.com/marquee.html.md) · [Repository source](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/master/docs/src/pages/marquee.astro) · [Matching tag](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/tree/v0.20.0)

Contract: ExpressiveCSS 0.20.0

Contract SHA-256: `9572eb9544e6bc2b462220e2535968147b0c19ca83f15ac6481f8e5cb70d07f4`

#### Selection and adaptation

Runtime ownership: `css-only`. No dedicated entry in the reviewed Google component inventory.

Example: Twelve customer logos under a landing page hero are a marquee. Four featured products people should open are a carousel or a card grid.

#### Material mapping

Relationship: none. Web extension; no dedicated entry was observed in the reviewed current M3 component inventory.

Support: Two identical groups that loop horizontally or vertically, with reverse, edge fades, a paused class, hover and focus pausing, token duration and gap, a reversed direction in RTL and a hand-scrolled strip under reduced motion.

Web adaptation: A visual copy of the item list marked aria-hidden, with its links taken out of the tab order, so assistive technology and the keyboard meet each item once.

Full parity remains unassessed. Review provenance and specification links: [capability evidence](../references/capability-roadmap.md#marquee).

#### Contract

A `.marquee` holds two identical `<ul class="marquee-content">` groups. The second is a copy that fills the gap as the first scrolls out, so mark it `aria-hidden="true"` and give each link or button in it `tabindex="-1"`. Each group is at least as wide as the strip and spreads short content out, so one copy is enough. Hovering over the strip or focusing a link inside pauses it. CSS only.

#### Syntax

```html
<div class="marquee fade">
  <ul class="marquee-content" aria-label="Customers">
    <li><img src="launchpad.svg" alt="Launchpad"></li>
    <li><a href="/customers/greenleaf"><img src="greenleaf.svg" alt="Greenleaf"></a></li>
  </ul>
  <ul class="marquee-content" aria-hidden="true">
    <li><img src="launchpad.svg" alt="Launchpad"></li>
    <li><a href="/customers/greenleaf" tabindex="-1"><img src="greenleaf.svg" alt="Greenleaf"></a></li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

#### Also documented

The Marquee section of the [API reference](https://www.expressivecss.com/llm.md) also covers Tokens.

#### Rules

- `marquee-copy-is-hidden`: The second .marquee-content repeats the first so the loop has no gap. Mark it aria-hidden="true" and give each link or button in it tabindex="-1", or a screen reader reads every item twice.
